rationaleNote: One card, kept for lesson 21 (subtract two 2-digit numbers), where the teacher can point at 48 + 25 and say "remember when we stopped at 70 first": it carries the bridging criteria word for word with the board's number line for that same case. The non-crossing criteria, the sticky fact and both misconceptions are already absorbed by these steps, so they stay on today's slides.

items.label: Step 1
items.text: {{Partition}} the second number into tens and ones.

items.label: Step 2
items.text: Count on the <<tens>> from the first number.

items.label: Step 3
items.text: Will the ones go past the next ten? If not, add them.

items.label: Step 4
items.text: If they will, add enough ones to <<reach the next ten>>.

items.label: Step 5
items.text: Add the ones that are left.
